import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/custom_field_definitions/%7Bcustom_field_definition_id%7D/custom_field_lov_entries?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bstart_with%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bactive%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Blabel_with%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
